title: Chambers Finder CLI answer to one request, schemaVersion 1
description: The fields of a successful single answer under --json (a batch holds these, plus index and ok, in items). Fields may be added within a major version; none is removed or changes meaning.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this answer format (1).

mode.description: "single" for one request; "batch" for a batch, where items[] holds one answer or error per request.

query.description: The request as it was read: the postcode and its outward code.

location.description: Where the postcode was placed: the centre of its postcode district, a few kilometres at most from any address in it.

radiusMiles.description: The travel radius used, in miles; null when the request said "all".

measureFrom.description: "court" or "postcode": where the chambers' distances start.

chosenCourt.description: The court the chambers are measured from: the nearest one, or the one named by courtId. Has rank, id, name, location, lat, lon, distanceMiles and source (nearest or court_id).

courts.description: The nearest courts, nearest first: rank, id, name, location, lat, lon and distanceMiles.

chambers.description: The nearest chambers, nearest first: rank, id, name, website, email (the clerks), phone, distanceMiles, distanceFromPostcodeMiles, withinRadius, and the nearest branch (name, city, address, phone, lat, lon).

items.description: distanceMiles is from the point measured from (the chosen court, or the postcode); the branch is the chambers' nearest branch to it.

chambersWithinRadius.description: How many chambers in all lie within the radius (not only the ones listed).

chambersConsidered.description: How many chambers were ranked in all.

data.description: Which data the answer came from: the directory's schema version and updatedOn date, and when the postcode table was built.

warnings.description: Notes that did not stop the answer.
